motivation: Autonomous research agents can implement experiment code, but their experiment portfolios often leave paper contributions weakly connected to evidence.

contribution.statement: A contribution-coverage planner that maps each paper contribution to sufficient main, ablation, case-study, and boundary evidence.
claims: The planner reaches complete contribution-to-evidence coverage.
The planner avoids redundant experiments while preserving required evidence roles.
contribution.scope: Experiment planning for empirical AI papers

baselines.name: Manual four-section template
baselines.full_configuration: One main, one ablation, one case study, and one extra analysis section without a coverage validator

metadata.purpose: Engineering contract fixture, not paper evidence
